mapper.select: SELECT s.name AS boutique, po.platform_order_id AS mabangNum, po.platform_order_number AS commandeNum, po.tracking_number AS suiviNum, po.order_time AS commandeDate, po.shipping_time AS expeditionDate, po.recipient AS clientName, po.country AS country, po.postcode AS postalCode, JSON_ARRAYAGG(sku.erp_code) AS sku, JSON_ARRAYAGG(sku.en_name) AS productName, JSON_ARRAYAGG(poc.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(poc.purchase_fee) AS purchaseFee, po.fret_fee AS fretFee, SUM(poc.shipping_fee) AS livraisonFee, po.order_service_fee + SUM(poc.service_fee) AS serviceFee, po.picking_fee + SUM(poc.picking_fee) AS pickingFee, po.packaging_material_fee AS packagingMaterialFee, po.insurance_fee AS insuranceFee, po.small_parcel_tax AS smallParcelTax, COALESCE(po.eu_customs_handling_fee, 0.00) AS euCustomsHandlingFee, SUM(poc.vat) AS TVA, po.shipping_invoice_number AS factureNum FROM platform_order po JOIN shop s ON po.shop_id = s.id JOIN platform_order_content poc ON po.id = poc.platform_order_id JOIN sku ON poc.sku_id = sku.id WHERE po.shipping_invoice_number = #{invoiceNumber} AND po.order_time > '2026-01-01' AND poc.erp_status <> 5 GROUP BY po.id, s.name, po.order_time ORDER BY s.name, po.order_time
SELECT * FROM detail_de_facture_avec_frais_achat WHERE `N° de facture` = #{invoiceNumber}
